notes.title: Update Notes for September 12th Patch
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Added extra precautions when saving and exiting the game, in order to make sure quest related information is saved properly.
[*] Added extra precautions when loading a save file, in order to make sure completed quests would not re-activate.
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple dialogue options would be incorrectly available during certain quests.
[*] Rebalanced the revitalization amount needed for unlocking the ascended pillars.
[*] Fixed an issue with the "A use for jelly" quest, where the Elder would refuse jelly from the player if they quit the game during the related quest step.
[*] Fixed an issue where holding the "jelly" inventory item and pressing the interact key could cause a crash when no appropriate actor was nearby.
[*] Fixed an issue where planting plots would not update their completion correctly on the map if the player moved to far away during their completion process.
[*] Construction boxes spawned inside walls or other objects will now be placed in the hearthship upon reloading the game.
[*] Added precautions to prevent NPC's from getting stuck behind the kitchen area when trying to navigate up the nearby ramp.
[*] Fixed an issue for the quest "Probe 13-L" when it was not activated through the hearthship's computer, causing the probe to not be interactable unless the player backtracked to a previous quest waypoint.
[/list]
 
[b]Adjustements and optimization[/b]

[list]
[*] Improvements to NPC dialogue management.
[*] Adjusted certain vista views.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Update regarding Distant Bloom
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, here comes a small update regarding Distant Bloom and the current state of the game.[/b]

First of all, we are overjoyed that so many of you decided to give Distant Bloom a try and the all around positive reception the game has received. It truly means the world to us to see something we worked on be able to bring a joyful experience to so many. 

With that said, we also know that the experience up until this point has not been without its faults and we want to profusely apologize for any frustration caused by the issues and bugs some of you have experienced within the game. While we haven't been able to respond to every post regarding these issues, please know that we try and do our best in keeping track of all noted bugs or errors reported.
 
We are happy to confirm that for the next few weeks we’ll be able to jump back into the project and do our best to fix as many of the issues as we can, with a special focus on critical issues and blockers.
 
In the coming days we will provide more information about the specific issues that we will be fixing as well as a date for next patch release.
 
Stay tuned and thanks as always for all your support.
 
Ember Trail

notes.title: Update Notes for April 18th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the crew's wishes were being reset upon having completed the main story. 
Wishes regarding decorations and repaired artifacts should be restored to their previous state but food items will unfortunately have to be re-gifted to the crew in order to be updated correctly.

notes.title: Have you discovered the Little Buddy Mode yet?
notes.content:
Distant Bloom is a game about exploring an alien planet and bringing it back to life. It's about ecology, sustainability, and love for nature, but it's also about family, friends, and the meaningful journey we can share with loved ones. 

Distant Bloom aims to make players of all ages feel happy, cozy, and safe, and most importantly, not alone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/70472a5130063acdf40a8ef6441f481809d04c44.gif[/img]

For these reasons, [b]we decided to add "Little Buddy Mode"[/b], which allows you to connect a second controller to your PC and have your little kid, sibling, or friend take control of the little robot Kei.ki. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/18a6d04c84f75511067fab8951a4e9a61bd9bf28.gif[/img]

[b]No, this doesn't make Distant Bloom a multiplayer game.[/b] All actions in the game will still be performed by the Assistant. However, the second player can keep you company and stroll around with you as you explore the world. 

The Little Buddy Mode isn't available right from the start of the game. To enable the option in your Menu, you'll first need to enter the Oasis. [b]Please note that this mode is experimental - tested and compatible with PS4, PS5, and Xbox controllers but untested with other devices on the market. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/bde0631c82406c645c28b618070439715a539240.gif[/img]

We hope this isn't too much of a spoiler and that you enjoy the mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/b4fbf482354253d5176bbc9638ce8bce9ce3141f.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Improvements and Fixes!
notes.content:
Today, we've implemented another set of fixes for Distant Bloom. This marks the fifth update since you got your hands on the game. During this time, you've provided us with valuable feedback that has helped us work on improving your gaming experience. In total we’ve managed to address over 25 issues and add quite a few 'quality of life' improvements! [b]Thank you for your involvement![/b]

Check out the full list of recent changes below:

[h3]April 8th [/h3]
[list]
[*] NPC's should spawn correctly in base after the main questline is completed. 
[*] Sick beasts should now properly display the "New Recipe Unlocked" notification when scanned (a minor blueprint node was missing). 
[*] The snot monsters near the Deep Timberlands crystallite have been removed, and the nearby root bridge has been replaced with a wooden bridge. 
[*] WASD movement in the UI should now be fully functional (the W key was not working properly). 
[*] Foliage suppression for buildings was somewhat incorrectly set up but should now be functioning properly (minor fix). 
[*] Loading zone fix for the wetlands 1 - forest 1 transition area. 
[*] Fixed a collision issue for the ascended architecture staircase near the Mederi vista point in forest 1. 
[*] Reverted plant sims to be blocked, fixed a bug in critter/creep monster spawn logic that could multiply the amount. 
[*] Added a Quality of Life (QOL) improvement for the base where we increase the number of critters when planting in hot pools and the quarry, as well as in the base itself. Also made it randomize so we don't only have snabels in the base.
[/list]

[h3]April 4th[/h3]
[list]
[*] Further improvements in Lightning during sunset/night hours.
[*] Issues with construction boxes disappearing or spawning more than once fixed.
[*] Quest sequence timer reduced from 30 seconds to 10 seconds (instances of the game getting idle at the start of a quest sequence should be greatly reduced).
[/list]

[h3]April 2nd[/h3]
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wetland probe potential blocker fixed.
[*] Loading Volume fix (Hot Pools).
[*] Potential blocker for Bahhan if the player saved during cooking fixed.
[*] Added colliders in the base for AI navigation issue fixes (NPCs getting blocked in different places around the base should be fixed).
[*] Bahhan/cook being busy and not wanting to cook anymore should be fixed.
[/list]

[b]QOL IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]
[list]
[*] Eye Shader improvements.
[*] Lighting improvements.
[*] Show seeds in harvest UI and prompt “seedbag full” UI if trying to collect with a full seedbag.
[*] Snot monsters only block the cell they sleep in (other cells can be pre-planted during the day).
[*] Snot monsters “cooldown” time between chomps greatly increased from 5-6 seconds to 45-60 seconds.
[*] Seedbag max size increased to 99 seeds per plant.
[/list]
[h3]
March 28th[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed non-removable trees.
[*] Fixed a potential hang activating Probe (quarry). 
[*] Map Bug Fix. 
[*] Potential sequence lock/bug fix. 
[*] Fixes and improvements to level design on certain vistas.
[/list]

notes.title: Distant Bloom is Available Now!
notes.content:
Distant Bloom is now available! Prepare for a cozy adventure on an alien planet where you'll nurture nature and witness its resurgence before your eyes. Enjoy a 10% discount for the launch.

The game invites you on a tranquil journey of management and exploration, where you'll discover the magic of nature and the importance of maintaining harmony in the world. No combat. No high scores. No pressure. Just an extraordinary adventure in an alien world.

Check out the Launch Trailer!
[previewyoutube=oULQk3lcod8;full][/previewyoutube]

After a long voyage through space, you and your crew touch down on an alien planet with the vital task of establishing a new home for your species. But this place is nothing like the lush paradise you envisioned. What happened to the vibrant life of this world? And what fate awaits you?

🗺️ Explore the desolate landscape and revive its lush past with the power of plants!
🌱 Cultivate new life by tending to a diverse array of alien flora. Experiment with plant structures and cultivate a thriving ecosystem!
🛠️ Transform your harvest into recipes, tools, and items to construct and enhance your home base.
👽 Bring together your scattered crew to form a community, each member with their own tale to tell.
📖 Venture into the wilderness to uncover the secrets of this peculiar planet. What—or who—left behind the enigmatic ruins scattered across the terrain?
🪐 Shape the world! Your choices will not only affect nature but also the fate of your crew.

Distant Bloom is also available in the Altra 3 Collection Bundle, featuring a serene and atmospheric Original Soundtrack, with a permanent 15% discount!

notes.title: 🌺 Distant Bloom is set to launch on March 27th, 2024!
notes.content:
🌼 Get ready to embark on a tranquil journey into the heart of nature with Distant Bloom, set to release on March 27th, 2024. This cozy adventure invites players to witness the transformation of a desolate world into a vibrant paradise.

🌿 Distant Bloom isn't about rushing through challenges; it's about savoring every moment of your management and exploration escapade. Join the cosmic expedition as you land on an alien planet, tasked with establishing a new home for your species. But beware, what you find isn't a lush paradise but a world in ruins.

🤖 With your trusty robot companion, Kei'ki, by your side, you'll set out to restore this planet's natural balance and breathe life back into its barren landscapes. Traverse through diverse biomes, from misty marshes to towering forests, each teeming with unique fauna waiting to be discovered.

🌱 As you gather resources, sow seeds, and expand your settlement, you'll encounter curious critters in need of aid and ancient ruins holding secrets of the planet's past. Distant Bloom is more than just a game; it's a journey of growth, harmony, and the power of nature's resilience.

🎮 Mark your calendars for March 27th, 2024, when Distant Bloom blooms onto Steam. For those eager to dive into this cozy adventure, a demo is available now on the Steam store page.

notes.title: Distant Bloom Devs Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Lately, we've been putting in some serious work to enhance the gaming experience for our players. Taking into account your incredible contributions, for which we're immensely grateful, and the feedback garnered from your gameplay in the demo version, our goal has been to implement these insights across all aspects of the game. Here's a summary of what we've been focusing on: 

🎮 [b]Game Design Balancing:[/b] Responding to your fantastic feedback on the demo experience and internal playtests, we've been fine-tuning game design for a more enjoyable player experience. 

🌍 [b]Redesigned Early Game: [/b]We've revamped the beginning of the game to enhance the initial steps and make it even more engaging. Players who experienced the demo will discover numerous improvements and differences in the early quests and the world's layout. Check out the Assistant's capsule crash site after the updates! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/91156fb2cbc61c1275779c3c24b2c4a7a94f481d.png[/img]

📸 [b]Dynamic Camera Implementation: [/b]Addressing your feedback about the static camera, we've introduced dynamic camera volumes and different vistas to give the experience a more cinematic feel. Behold the crash site of Bahhan's capsule. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/0969cbd41f9ba640a11cb1512029d96d07a48878.png[/img]

🎨 [b]Visual Polish: [/b]Working tirelessly on polishing and improving the game's visuals! Brand new fancy lighting, volumetric fog, and particle enhancements make Alter 2 shine brighter than ever. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/6b91a509d398f1fd8368ed8edeebe13f4288f912.png[/img]

🤖 [b]AI and World Interaction:[/b] Significant efforts have gone into improving the AI of NPCs and creatures, creating routines to make the in-game world feel more alive. 

We'll keep you updated on our progress, and we hope you join us on this cozy journey to rebuild the environment! 🌟🎮🌳

notes.title: Distant Bloom is coming to Steam in Q1 2024
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the upcoming release of Distant Bloom, a serene management game that invites you to explore an alien world and rejuvenate its natural beauty. The game is scheduled for release in the first quarter of 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42826212/ab152221774f2f3b671dc0844797f3fed0c877db.jpg[/img]

Regrettably, we want to extend our sincere apologies to our community for the recent lack of updates. Due to unforeseen circumstances, we had to temporarily halt progress on the project. However, we're delighted to share that we've overcome all challenges and are now in the final stretch, dedicated to delivering the best possible game. 

We can't wait for you to experience the joy of playing Distant Bloom. Your ongoing support means the world to us. Thank you! 

Best regards,  

The Distant Bloom Team
